fullDescription: Elegant luxury editorial style guide featuring a deep burgundy (#8B3A47) and warm cream (#F5E6D3) palette. High-end aesthetic for wellness, lifestyle, or premium services. Includes sophisticated typography pairing 'Crimson Pro' serifs with 'Poppins' sans-serifs, delicate SVG breathing animations, organic blob shapes, and a subtle grid line pattern overlay. Optimized for minimalist yet visually rich landing pages with tight, premium spacing and high-contrast interactive elements.

structured.summary: A premium luxury design system characterized by an editorial aesthetic, using deep burgundy, gold, and warm cream tones. It balances minimalist layouts with rich decorative elements like subtle line patterns and organic, animated shapes. The design emphasizes calm and sophistication through breathing animations and high-contrast typography.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'luxury editorial' feel. Typography uses a mix of light-weight serifs for large headings (Crimson Pro) and modern, uppercase sans-serifs for meta-text (Poppins). The color system is anchored by Deep Burgundy (#8B3A47), Warm Cream (#F5E6D3), and Gold (#D4A574). Motion is subtle: breathing SVG circles for tranquility and smooth scroll-reveals (transform-Y: 20px) for interactivity.
style.prompt: Create a luxury editorial style UI using a palette of Deep Burgundy (#8B3A47), Warm Cream (#F5E6D3), Accent Gold (#D4A574), Muted Gray (#7A8A8E), and an off-white background (#FFFBF7). Typography must pair 'Crimson Pro' (headings, weights 300/400, italic variations) with 'Poppins' (body and navigation, weights 400/600). Use extremely wide tracking (0.2em) for small uppercase labels (10px). Backgrounds should include a faint line-pattern grid (linear-gradient, 40px square, 5% opacity). Buttons use #8B3A47 background with white text, sharp edges (rounded-sm), and high-contrast hover effects. Incorporate organic, fluid shapes (border-radius: 60% 40% 30% 70% / 60% 30% 70% 40%) as background decorative elements with blur-2xl filters. Key animations include a 'breathing' effect for SVG circles (scale 1.0 to 1.15, opacity 0.3 to 0.6 over 8 seconds) and scroll-triggered fades.

layout_and_structure.description: Compact and premium layout with tight vertical padding (py-16 to py-24). Sections are separated by delicate borders (#E5D1B8) or subtle background shifts. Uses a mix of single-column centered quote sections, 2-column hero/editorial splits, and 3-to-4 column grids for services and social proof.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header with backdrop-blur (rgba(255,251,247, 0.98)). Logo on the far left in primary burgundy. Navigation links centered using 11px uppercase Poppins with 0.2em tracking. Add a hover micro-interaction where a small Lucide icon fades in next to the text. Far right includes a user icon and a 'Book' CTA button (10px, uppercase, high contrast).

Two-column split. Left side: Small pill-shaped tag, a large 7xl serif heading (Crimson Pro) with italicized emphasis, and a descriptive paragraph. Right side: Abstract animated visual instead of an image. Visual consists of concentric SVG circles with a breathing animation (scale/opacity) and a central Lucide icon pulsating softly.

3-column grid of white cards with #E5D1B8 borders. Each card has a circular icon container that switches from cream to burgundy on hover. Includes a 2xl serif title, a small body text, and a bottom row containing a hidden 'View Details' label that appears on hover alongside a rotating '+' icon.

High-contrast section using the primary burgundy background (#8B3A47) and white text. Left side contains a vertical list of quotes with varying opacities (90%, 70%, 50%) paired with accent gold borders. Right side features floating glassmorphism cards and organic blobs spinning at 40s linear-infinite speeds.

3-column grid using light backgrounds and quote icons. Each testimonial card is border-wrapped with a specific accent border on the central card for emphasis. Profiles include circular initials placeholders and 10px bold uppercase metadata.

Grid of product or showcase cards. Square aspect ratio images with a slight 700ms scale-up transition on hover. Each card displays a serif title, price/meta in burgundy, and a full-width flat button that transitions from transparent to solid burgundy.

4-column layout with primary burgundy text on the light background. Includes a newsletter/description block, two link columns, and a contact column with icons. Bottom bar contains copyright and utility links in 9px uppercase bold text with 0.2em tracking.

special_ui_components.description: A tranquil, non-human visual element using animated geometry.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a centered SVG container (500px) with 3 concentric circles. Apply a CSS animation 'breath' (keyframes: 0% scale 1, 50% scale 1.15, 100% scale 1) with an 8-second duration. Use linear-gradient fills (#8B3A47 at 20% opacity to #D4A574 at 10% opacity). Layer a central Lucide flower icon at 20% opacity with a pulse effect.

special_ui_components.description: Decorative fluid shapes that add a premium feel to backgrounds.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design a CSS element with 'border-radius: 60% 40% 30% 70% / 60% 30% 70% 40%'. Set background to #F5E6D3 or white/10% depending on parent section. Apply a 'blur-2xl' filter and position it as an absolute z-index -10 element to peek from behind content.

structured.special_notes: Maintain strict vertical padding limits (max py-24 for large screens, py-16 for mobile) to keep the layout feeling premium and dense rather than sparse. Every section heading should have a 10px uppercase tracking label above it. Use Crimson Pro's italic variant for emotional emphasis within headings. Border-radius should be minimal (rounded-sm) except for decorative 'organic blobs'.
